entities.summary: Gustavo Adolfo Madero González, born in Parras de la Fuente, Coahuila, Mexico, was a participant in the Mexican Revolution against Porfirio Díaz along with other members of his wealthy family. He was also known as "Ojo Parado" since he had one glass eye.
